announcements.headline: Eramet outlines its short- and medium-term operational and strategic roadmap
announcements.insight: Following H1 EBITDA rebound and funding execution, this roadmap outlines strategic direction. Shareholders should monitor progress against these operational targets.

announcements.headline: EBITDA rebound in H1 2026; execution of the funding plan underway, essential for the Group in H2
announcements.insight: EBITDA rebound in H1 2026 supports the execution of the funding plan mentioned in the May 2026 capital approval. This progress is essential for the Group in H2.

announcements.headline: General Meeting on May 27th, 2026: approval of the resolution regarding the €500m capital increase
announcements.insight: Shareholders must vote to approve a €500m capital increase at the May 27th General Meeting. This funding action could significantly alter equity structures.
